This GDPR policy outlines Blankspace's commitment to comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) to ensure the protection and privacy of personal data of individuals within the European Union, including Belgium.
Scope

This policy applies to all personal data processed by Blankspace, irrespective of the format or location where it is stored or used. This includes data collected through our website, including the use of Google Analytics and AdWords tracking cookies. All employees, contractors, and third parties working with Blankspace are expected to adhere to this policy.
Principles

items.label: Lawfulness, Fairness, and Transparency
items.text: Blankspace shall process personal data lawfully, fairly, and in a transparent manner, ensuring the rights of data subjects are respected.

items.label: Purpose Limitation
items.text: Personal data shall be collected for specified, explicit, and legitimate purposes and not further processed in a manner that is incompatible with those purposes.

items.label: Data Minimization
items.text: Blankspace shall ensure that personal data is adequate, relevant, and limited to what is necessary in relation to the purposes for which it is processed.

items.label: Accuracy
items.text: Blankspace shall take reasonable steps to ensure the accuracy of personal data and rectify inaccurate or incomplete data without undue delay.

items.label: Storage Limitation
items.text: Personal data shall be kept in a form that permits identification of data subjects for no longer than is necessary for the purposes for which the personal data is processed.

items.label: Integrity and Confidentiality
items.text: Blankspace shall ensure the security and confidentiality of personal data through appropriate technical and organizational measures.

blocks.text: Data Subject Rights
Data subjects have the right to request access to, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, and portability of their personal data.
Data Protection Officer
Blankspace has appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) responsible for overseeing the company's data protection strategy and ensuring GDPR compliance.
The DPO can be reached at jamil@blankspace.brussels.
Data Processing Procedures
Blankspace shall document all data processing activities, including purposes, categories of data, recipients, and storage periods, in line with the GDPR requirements.
This includes data collected through Google Analytics and AdWords tracking cookies.
Data Breach Notification

In case of a data breach that is likely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals, Blankspace shall notify the Belgian Data Protection Authority (DPA) and affected data subjects within 72 hours.
This includes data breaches related to Google Analytics and AdWords tracking cookies.
Third-Party Processing

Blankspace shall ensure that any third parties processing personal data on its behalf, including services like Google Analytics and AdWords, are GDPR-compliant and have appropriate data processing agreements in place.
Training and Awareness
Blankspace shall provide GDPR training to employees and raise awareness of the importance of data protection and privacy.
Review and Update

This GDPR policy will be regularly reviewed and updated to ensure its effectiveness and compliance with changes in laws and regulations. By adhering to this GDPR policy, Blankspace aims to safeguard the rights and privacy of individuals and ensure GDPR compliance in all data processing activities, including those involving Google Analytics and AdWords tracking cookies.

body.text: In the bustling world of modern workplaces, the need for tranquility and a connection to nature has never been more pronounced. Enter Greenmood, the Belgian pioneer in biophilic design. Founded in 2014 by Sadig Alekperov, Greenmood has been a beacon of green innovation, specializing in creating green walls and 100% natural indoor acoustic solutions. Now, they're bringing their expertise to blankspace, an exciting new event venue, to offer an experience that will leave you inspired and rejuvenated.

Collaborating with renowned designers like Alain Gilles, Greenmood's pieces aim to transform commercial spaces into natural sanctuaries. Imagine stepping into your workplace and being greeted by the splendor of the natural world. With Greenmood, that dream becomes a reality.

Greenmood's workshops at blankspace offer a unique opportunity to get hands-on with nature. You can create your very own preserved moss frame artwork, selecting from a variety of colors and textures of preserved moss. With the guidance of Greenmood's talented frame designer, you'll craft your own green masterpiece.

There are two distinct workshop styles to choose from. The first allows you to create your own green composition with preserved foliage, a shorter yet satisfying experience. You get to take home your creation, which can thrive up to 7 years with no maintenance at all, thanks to the preservation process. The second style is perfect for team-building with colleagues, a fantastic opportunity to foster office camaraderie. In this workshop, you'll work with actual moss, a species akin to algae and mushrooms. It's not a plant, and it's not technically dead, providing a fascinating medium for your artistic expression.

Greenmood's biophilic workshops at blankspace are an invitation to nurture your connection with nature and bring its beauty into your workspace. Don't miss this chance to create your own piece of natural art while basking in the serenity of Greenmood's expertise. We can not wait for you to come and experience the transformative power of biophilic design.
